name: plan-arm
description: The plan pipeline: architect -> test-writer -> (expected-red) -> dev -> (green) -> publish. Works GREENFIELD or on an EXISTING branch. A forge git CLONE brings the repo's .git into the shared volume; each blacksmith/agent commits its own work as one conventional commit per landed write; the forge/run steps run the checks. With `ref` set the pipeline extends/fixes that existing branch (an open PR): the architect updates PLAN.md, the test author adds/updates the RED tests, the dev makes them pass, and publish pushes the new commits back onto `ref` so the PR updates in place. With `ref` empty it builds greenfield and publish opens a git-factory PR to dev named by the highest-impact commit type. Scanning and security/quality review are the pr-review workflow's job (it runs on the PR). Inputs {task, namespace, repo, ref?}.

inputs.name: task
inputs.description: the work to build, or the issues to fix

inputs.name: ref
inputs.description: an existing branch to extend/fix and push back to (a PR branch); empty = greenfield + open a new dev PR

with.run: set -e; export HOME=/tmp GOCACHE=/tmp/gocache GOPATH=/tmp/go; git config --global --add safe.directory '*'; REF='${inputs.ref}'; TOK=$(printf '%s' "$GIT_URL" | sed -E 's#.*//[^:/]+:([^@]+)@.*#\1#'); GF=http://codearmory-git-factory:9002; REPO='${inputs.repo}'; if [ -n "$REF" ]; then git clone -q "$GIT_URL" /workspace; cd /workspace; git checkout -q "$REF"; echo "working on existing branch $REF:"; git log --oneline -1; else CODE=$(curl -s -o /tmp/r -w '%{http_code}' -X POST "$GF/repos" -H "authorization: Bearer $TOK" -H 'content-type: application/json' -d "{\"name\":\"$REPO\",\"visibility\":\"private\"}"); case "$CODE" in 201|409) ;; *) echo "repo create failed $CODE"; cat /tmp/r; exit 1;; esac; if ! git ls-remote --exit-code --heads "$GIT_URL" main >/dev/null 2>&1; then D=$(mktemp -d); git -C "$D" init -q; git -C "$D" -c user.email=blacksmith@codearmory -c user.name=blacksmith commit -q --allow-empty -m 'chore: init main'; git -C "$D" push "$GIT_URL" HEAD:refs/heads/main; fi; git clone -q "$GIT_URL" /workspace; cd /workspace; git checkout -q main; echo 'cloned:'; git log --oneline -1; fi

export HOME=/tmp GOCACHE=/gocache/build GOMODCACHE=/gocache/mod GOFLAGS=-buildvcs=false && mkdir -p /gocache/build /gocache/mod && cd /workspace && echo '=== TREE ===' && find . -type f -not -path './.git/*' | sort && echo '=== go test ===' && (go test ./... 2>&1 | tail -20)

set -e; export HOME=/tmp; git config --global --add safe.directory '*'; cd /workspace; TOK=$(printf '%s' "$GIT_URL" | sed -E 's#.*//[^:/]+:([^@]+)@.*#\1#'); GF=http://codearmory-git-factory:9002; REPO='${inputs.repo}'; REF='${inputs.ref}'; if [ -n "$REF" ]; then BASE=$(git rev-parse "origin/$REF"); if [ "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$BASE" ]; then echo 'no new commits -- nothing to push'; exit 0; fi; git push "$GIT_URL" HEAD:refs/heads/$REF; echo "pushed the change to $REF"; exit 0; fi; BASE=$(git rev-parse origin/main); if [ "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$BASE" ]; then echo 'no commits from the stages -- nothing to publish'; exit 0; fi; TYPES=$(git log "$BASE"..HEAD --format=%s | sed -E 's/^([a-z]+)(\(.*\))?!?:.*/\1/' | sort -u); TYPE=chore; for t in feat fix perf refactor docs test build ci chore style revert; do if printf '%s\n' "$TYPES" | grep -qx "$t"; then TYPE=$t; break; fi; done; SLUG=$(printf '%s' "${inputs.task}" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]' | tr -cs 'a-z0-9' '-' | sed -E 's/^-+//; s/-+$//' | cut -c1-40 | sed -E 's/-+$//'); [ -z "$SLUG" ] && SLUG=change; BR=$TYPE/${SLUG}; if ! git ls-remote --exit-code --heads "$GIT_URL" dev >/dev/null 2>&1; then git push "$GIT_URL" "$BASE":refs/heads/dev; fi; git push "$GIT_URL" HEAD:refs/heads/$BR; RID=$(curl -s "$GF/repos" -H "authorization: Bearer $TOK" | tr '{' '\n' | grep "\"name\":\"$REPO\"" | sed -E 's/.*\"id\":\"([^\"]+)\".*/\1/' | head -1); PR=$(curl -s -X POST "$GF/repos/$RID/pulls" -H "authorization: Bearer $TOK" -H 'content-type: application/json' -d "{\"title\":\"$TYPE: ${inputs.task}\",\"source_ref\":\"$BR\",\"target_ref\":\"dev\"}"); echo "$PR"; echo PR_OPENED
